group: Authenticated agents connected to a live GUI session
scope: One x64 GUI-owned automatic routing session, app-local virtual input, three original seats and four explicitly owned disposable x64/x86 target applications. PID permissions restrict actual native recipients, rather than confining virtual overlay coordinates.
coverage: Actual descriptor and pipe security descriptors each have one protected full-access logon-SID ACE. Wrong bearer token rejected; two authenticated raw clients have distinct IDs and matching overlapping sequence-1 command acknowledgements.

GUI/manual F5 remains held through two agents claiming/releasing/disconnecting the same key, with no extra native key edge. Connected MCP's actor-only F7 is released on EOF while another actor's F8 and GUI F5 survive; other seat's F6 remains held and GUI session stays alive. Actor text reaches the actual own EDIT control.

Unpermitted user, capture permission and settings/mode/pause mutations reject without releasing original holds. Motion over excluded owned D may target allowed existing focus A, while a button hit at D rejects. After the operator genuinely selects D, agent key, absolute motion toward allowed A and speed-8 relative motion all reject before any D native event.

Actual capture permission controls and matched policy ACK enable selected-target PNG delivery. Decoded small and large RGBA images contain the known owned source color and white registration mark, with exact selected PID/HWND/user metadata. Native B F9 is observed while the large capture reply is outstanding.

Actual Disable revokes subsequent agent input, releases only agent ownership, preserves original GUI holds, removes descriptor/listener, and permits a fresh descriptor/broker. Final operator Stop releases input, destroys native cursor HWNDs and removes the fresh descriptor/listener; every raw handle and connected MCP process closes.

After explicit grant for all active users and session control, Settings ACK updates source profile and actual GUI ring/badge cursor telemetry. Mode ACK updates switched/shared-keyboard profile. Agent Pause renders the actual GUI Resume control; agent Resume restores the actual Pause control. Their intentional authorized input releases occur after preservation tests.

capture_measurements.measurement_note: The original responsiveness-prefix pixels field is requested outer dimensions 4000x3990, not actual client area. Accepted PNG metadata supplies the actual 3979x3986 dimensions above. The runner now obtains client dimensions directly; accepted original evidence remains byte-exact. No rerun was needed for this measurement correction.

visuals.review: Independent pixel review shows actual Agent Access process/permission/connection controls, enabled access and connected clients. Only owned names/PIDs and descriptor path are visible; the bearer token and token-bearing pipe name are absent.

retained_failed_attempts.reason: Real empty nonblocking pipe read was treated as disconnect. Repaired with native pipe availability handling; the generic reader retains normal EOF behavior.
Harness edited point coordinates but omitted the actual Move to point control before clicking. The product correctly kept its previous cursor location.

Real large PNG JSON reply stalled when a whole nonblocking write exceeded pipe quota. Repaired with bounded 16KiB chunks; final full gate delivers the actual large PNG within the unchanged 15-second reader deadline.

producer_verification: docs/gui-agents-rust-checks-2026-10-14.json records fmt, strict Clippy, 95 workspace tests and both builds, including real idle/data/disconnect and large-frame pipe regressions. Producer checks are separate from independent native/UI evidence.
limits: No hardware or RustDesk input used for control or validation; no OS input injection. Passive device discovery is not claimed disabled.
Only the x64 GUI/controller and same-logon local clients were run, with x64/x86 owned targets. No cross-logon, remote pipe, client-capacity overload or forced provider failure test.

The responsiveness measurement covers this actual large native/pixel/PNG job. It does not claim blocked PrintWindow behavior, general latency guarantees or arbitrary application capture compatibility.

Delayed replication scope changes, alternate actors with queued macro programs, full same-process isolation and full MouseMux Ultra parity were not independently exercised here. Historical feature suites were not broadly repeated.
Forced failed-run GUI termination required runner removal of its stale private descriptor. Successful Disable/Stop cleanup is product-driven; crash recovery is not claimed.
